market_thesis: U.S. homeowners actively compare costly, structurally inconsistent solar and battery proposals; exact KDP workbook competition is weak while adjacent solar guides show recent entrant traction.
product_thesis: A vendor-neutral paper workbook that converts 2–4 real proposals into one comparable decision packet.
buyer: U.S. homeowner holding two or more rooftop-solar/battery proposals
buyer_job: normalize proposals before signing a high-value contract
promise: Make competing proposals comparable and expose the questions that must be resolved before signing.
non_promise: No savings guarantee, installer recommendation, engineering design, tax, financial or legal advice.
better_or_faster: Complete a disciplined comparison in one sitting instead of reconciling multiple sales formats ad hoc.
specific_advantage: Buyer proposals → normalized cash/loan, equipment, assumptions, warranty and exclusion fields → an apples-to-apples sign-or-question decision packet.

raw_data_transformation.raw_source: the buyer’s actual proposals plus DOE/CFPB/FTC decision criteria
raw_data_transformation.transformation: extracts cash price, financed principal, cost per watt, production assumptions, equipment, warranties, exclusions and transfer terms into a comparable decision record
raw_data_transformation.buyer_value: independent reusable paper workspace that works with quotes from any installer, not lead-generation software

paid_value: independent reusable paper workspace that works with quotes from any installer, not lead-generation software
intentionally_not: A solar installation manual, lead-generation marketplace, ROI promise or financing recommendation.

format_specific_commercial_role.KINDLE: NOT_JUSTIFIED unless converted into a non-writable companion

format_constraint: Writing and side-by-side comparison make reflowable Kindle a poor primary fit.
format_opportunity: English paperback is supported and matches the physical decision job.
source_model: DOE, CFPB, FTC and other authoritative current sources control factual guidance; user proposals are the working inputs.
rights_model: Original worksheets and paraphrased government guidance with source attribution; no competitor text or proprietary proposal template reproduced.
author_model: Neutral imprint; no invented installer, engineering, financial or legal credentials.
factual_qa: Every factual claim maps to a dated source ledger; calculations have deterministic worked tests; annual and pre-publication refresh.
language_qa: English editorial pass and prohibited-claim scan.
product_quality_qa: Representative pages must prove quote normalization, decision usefulness and writable print ergonomics.
editorial_formalism_qa: Reject repeated empty forms, template leakage, unexplained fields, slide-page rhythm and generic filler.
human_product_gate: REQUIRED before full production because value depends on worksheet interaction and hierarchy.
technical_qa: Print TOC, writable spacing, no-bleed object audit, fonts, page geometry, formula fixtures and KDP Previewer.
commercial_package_requirements: Current Amazon rescan, print cost, paperback price, seven keywords, three category targets, truthful neutral description and cover brief after layout freeze.

economics.advertising_assumption: organic test; paid ads not required for thesis

kill_conditions: pre-production Amazon rescan finds multiple direct workbooks with meaningful traction
authoritative source model cannot support a field
scope drifts into individualized financing/tax/legal or engineering advice
